name: qeemah
description: Qeemah Accounting & ZATCA e-invoicing inspector for Saudi Arabia. Validate UBL 2.1 XML invoices, decode Phase 2 QR codes, and verify VAT compliance.

interface.longDescription: Qeemah is the ZATCA-compliant accounting platform for Saudi Arabia. This extension allows ChatGPT users to inspect Saudi e-invoices (XML and PDF), verify cryptographic stamps, decode TLV QR codes, check KSA business rules (KSA-1 to KSA-16), calculate 15% VAT, and review quarterly VAT returns and financial health metrics.
defaultPrompt: Inspect and audit this Saudi ZATCA invoice XML.
Show the VAT return and CFO dashboard for Q3 2026.
Draft a compliant B2B tax invoice with 15% VAT.
